system.description:
A ranged specialist who has given up melee training for precision at distance, from the archers' butts of Eltor to the gun companies of Opal.

  • Dead Reckoning: your bow and crossbow attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover, and score a critical hit on a 19 or 20 against a target with no cover or an unaware one.
    • 9th level: your bow or crossbow has no Disadvantage at long range, and its long range doubles.
  • Trained Eye: Advantage on checks estimating range, wind, elevation or trajectory, and you can name the make and origin of any arrow or bolt you examine.
